description: Angular component for a navigational tree with search and editing capabilities, utilizing jstree library.

classes.name: NavTreeNodeState
classes.description: Interface representing the state of a navigation tree node, including disabled, opened, and loaded flags.

classes.name: NavTreeNode
classes.description: Interface representing a node in the navigation tree, including id, icon, text, state, children, and data.

classes.name: NavTreeEditCallbacks
classes.description: Interface defining callback functions for editing operations on tree nodes, such as select, get, open, refresh, update, create, delete, enable, disable, set children, and search.

classes.name: NavTreeComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a navigational tree with search and editing features, integrating jstree library.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that initializes the tree component after construction.

methods.name: initTree
methods.description: Initializes the jstree with configuration, event handlers, and callback integrations.
